trivia.animalia.dissostichus_eleginoides: The Chilean Sea Bass, also known as the Patagonian Toothfish is an icefish that lives in the southern cold oceans at depths of 45 to over 3000 meters deep.
trivia.animalia.percophis_brasiliensis: The Brazilian Flathead is considered to be the most basal member of Notothenioidei. It lives off the coast of Brazil and Argentina.
trivia.animalia.eleginops_maclovinus: The Patagonian Blennie is known to live in estuarine and coastal habitats off Argentina and Chile.
trivia.animalia.pseudaphritis_urvillii: The Congoli is a fish endemic to the estuaries of south Australia. It is a carnivorous ambush predator.
trivia.animalia.betta_splendens: The Betta fish is a popular aquarium trade fish known for the striking colors and patterns it can have. The wild forms are duller in appearance.
trivia.animalia.synbranchus_marmoratus: The marbled swamp eel is a nocturnal predator that sometimes burrows into the ground to find concealed animals. It burrows deeper during drier periods to stay below the water table.
trivia.animalia.chaudhuria_caudata: This animal is around 6cm in length, and does not possess scales. Very little is known about their habits or their biology. Both the dorsal and anal fins lack spines.
trivia.animalia.mastacembelus_armatus: The Zig-zag Eel, or Tire-track eel is a freshwater spiny eel native to South and Southeast Asia. They are popular in the aquarium trade for their striking patterns and color.
trivia.animalia.mastacembelus_erythrotae: The Fire Eel is a large spiny eel, able to grow up to 1 meter in length. They live in slow-moving rivers along the muddy substrate, and are native to Southeast Asia.
trivia.animalia.macrognathus_siamensis: The Peacock Eel is native to the Mekong basin and lives near the riverbed. They burrow into the substrate to hunt for invertebrates or hide from predators.
trivia.animalia.mastacembelus_brichardi: Blind Spiny Eels are a rare species of Mastacembelus found in the Congo River. They typically prey on small invertebrates. As they are blind, they use their strong senses to hunt.
trivia.animalia.sinobdella_sinensis: This species is native to southern China, Taiwan, and Vietnam. It is moderately sized, growing up to 38cm in total length. They prey on small invertebrates.
trivia.animalia.rakthamichthys_indicus: These are blind swamp eels endemic to India. They live underground, in streams throughout caves. This fish has a bright red coloration and incredibly reduced eyes.
trivia.animalia.nematistius_pectoralis: Roosterfish are fast-moving pelagic predators with uniquely long spines on their dorsal fins. They are large, able to reach over 1.6m in length and are a popular sport fish.
trivia.animalia.toxotes_chatareus: Archerfish are able to spit streams of water to knock insects into the water. They are able to hit distances of over 1m. Their diet typically consists of zooplankton and invertebrates.
trivia.animalia.pogonophryne_marmorata: This species of plunderfish is found in cold and deep antarctic waters. They have a flattened head and a mental barbel, which it uses as a sensory mechanism to find prey.
trivia.animalia.chaenocephalus_aceratus: The blackfin icefish lives on the Antarctic continental shelf. They have translucent blood and they lack haemoglobin. Male icefish are known to guard their nests after breeding.
trivia.animalia.cygnodraco_mawsoni: This species of dragonfish lives around the Antarctic continental shelf. They are a demersal species that feeds on other smaller fish and invertebrates. They can be found at depths of up to 300m.
trivia.animalia.scatophagus_argus: Spotted Scats are omnivorous freshwater to saltwater fish. Despite the name, eating dung has not been confirmed for this species. They can form small schools.
trivia.animalia.procambarus_clarkii: This species of crayfish is dark red and brown in appearance. They are found in warm freshwater ecosystems and can tolerate rather long dry spells.
trivia.animalia.procambarus_alleni: This species of crayfish is popular in the aquarium trade. In the wild it is generally tan-blue, although a selectively bred strain achieves a vibrant blue color.
trivia.animalia.procambarus_lucifugus: This species of crayfish is blind and troglomorphic. Its coloration is dull and pinkish and it only lives in caves in Florida.
trivia.animalia.procambarus_virginalis: This species of crayfish is widespread and considered an invasive species as they are able to reproduce via parthenogenesis.
trivia.animalia.pangasianodon_gigas: The Mekong Giant Catfish is a critically endangered large catfish found only in the Mekong River basin. They are toothless and feed on algae.
trivia.animalia.naso_brevirostris: These fish have a bony protrusion on their head, giving them the unicorn name. Adults generally feed on zooplankton while juveniles feed on algae.
trivia.animalia.pomacanthus_imperator: Juvenile Emperor Angelfish are strikingly different from the adults, bearing vibrant blue and white markings. The adults are striped with yellow and blue stripes and a dark mask. It typically eats sponges.
trivia.animalia.zanclus_cornutus: Moorish Idols have a high and laterally compressed body with a thin snout. They have small bristle-like teeth they use to feed on corals, tunicates, and other invertebrates. They can be found in small groups
trivia.animalia.paracanthurus_hepatus: Royal Blue Tangs are blue and yellow surgeonfish that are generally found in the Indo-Pacific. They are associated with coral reefs and eat algae that may harm the corals.
trivia.animalia.chaetodon_auriga: Threadfin butterflyfish are distributed in the Indo-Pacific region and generally found in shallow coral reefs. They have prominent yellow dorsal fins with a trailing filament and black bands running across its white body.
trivia.animalia.chelmon_rostratus: Copperband butterflyfish are usually found in shallow coral reefs in pairs or alone. They have a tube-like mouth used for feeding on small invertebrates such as tubeworms and clams.
trivia.animalia.siganus_vulpinus: The foxface rabbitfish is a reef fish found in the Indo-Pacific region. They are omnivorous and are usually found alone or in pairs. At night, the rabbitfish's colors become duller and mottled.
trivia.animalia.zebrasoma_flavescens: The Yellow Tang is a bright yellow surgeonfish that is commonly found in coral reefs. They generally eat algae and at night, a pale white band develops in the middle of their body.
trivia.animalia.zebrasoma_velifer: The Sailfin Tang is a brown and yellow colored surgeonfish known for its sail-like dorsal and anal fins which it can extend outwards. They generally graze on leafy algae.
trivia.animalia.hydrocynus_goliath: Goliath Tigerfish is a large fish native to African freshwater environments such as the Congo and Lake Tanganyika. It is a general piscivore but are also known to attack larger animals when food is scarce.

gui.animalia.holonet.welcome.line4: Field Guid App: All other creatures
gui.animalia.holonet.welcome.line3: Fish Compendium: True to its name... Fish!
gui.animalia.holonet.welcome.line2: Scan creatures by left or right clicking them.
gui.animalia.holonet.tutorial.scanning.b:
Scan living creatures by left or right clicking them. 

Some animals are particularly rare. Good luck trying to find them all!
gui.animalia.holonet.tutorial.gene_inher:
A few creatures are able to pass on their traits to their offspring with this system. The Betta fish will be the example here. 

Breeding two different parents will result in children with combined traits. Mutations can also occur at a 10% rate. Some mutatable traits have prerequisite parent traits, while others can appear from any parent trait.
gui.animalia.holonet.tutorial.filter_tra:
This device is used to catch small creatures used as breeding items for your other animals. 
All you need to do is place it in water, and insert fish meat or fish food. Then wait as the trap fills up. 

Different critters can be caught in different biomes in this way.
